C_interning_brings_ratio_under_threshold.can_fail_because: the interned mean depth ratio reads at or above 10.0x
C_interning_brings_ratio_under_threshold.must_fire_because: this spike's declared falsifier: if it does not fire, key length is not the cause of S75's 18.4x and S75's mechanism claim is wrong
C_interning_brings_ratio_under_threshold.name: C_interning_brings_ratio_under_threshold
C_interning_brings_ratio_under_threshold.null_must_contain: the same instrument that produced 18.39x, so the scale can contain both outcomes and the threshold is reachable from either side

C_interning_is_injective.can_fail_because: any atom fails to round-trip, or two distinct atoms encode to one key (fewer keys than atoms)
C_interning_is_injective.must_fire_because: a shorter encoding that collides or drops information would produce exactly the depth improvement this spike claims, so soundness has to be established before the measurement is read
C_interning_is_injective.name: C_interning_is_injective
C_interning_is_injective.null_must_contain: a collision, which this encoding can express: 1713 symbols share a 4-byte id space and the arity field is fixed-width, so distinct atoms CAN be driven to one key

C_key_length_actually_fell.can_fail_because: interned keys are not shorter than the original encoding on both max and mean
C_key_length_actually_fell.must_fire_because: the mechanism claimed is key length, so key length must be observed falling before any depth result is attributed to it
C_key_length_actually_fell.name: C_key_length_actually_fell
C_key_length_actually_fell.null_must_contain: the original encoding measured in THIS run, which is free to come out shorter than the interned one -- 4-byte ids are longer than any symbol of 1 character

C_original_replay_reproduces_S75.can_fail_because: the replayed mean depth or node count differs from S75/compare.json by any amount
C_original_replay_reproduces_S75.must_fire_because: the strongest available check that the instrument did not move: S75's own encoding, replayed through the same binary in this session, must land on the number S75 committed
C_original_replay_reproduces_S75.name: C_original_replay_reproduces_S75
C_original_replay_reproduces_S75.null_must_contain: S75's committed 139.05 mean pathmap depth and 83,210 nodes, recorded before this spike existed and not adjustable by it

C_ratio_moves_with_id_width.can_fail_because: the depth ratio does not decrease monotonically as mean key bytes decrease across the four variants
C_ratio_moves_with_id_width.must_fire_because: one threshold crossing is one point (A18); if key length is the variable then narrowing the id must move the ratio in the same direction, and if it does not, something else is doing the work
C_ratio_moves_with_id_width.name: C_ratio_moves_with_id_width
C_ratio_moves_with_id_width.null_must_contain: four encodings over ONE atom set, so a flat ratio across differing key lengths is an expressible outcome

observations.affine_verdict: adjacent slopes span 0.1455..0.1947 (34% > 25%): NOT affine. Report the measured points, not a rate.

C_symbol_ids_are_canonical.can_fail_because: rebuilding the table from the shuffled order yields any different id
C_symbol_ids_are_canonical.must_fire_because: an id assignment depending on read order makes two honest parties commit to different keys for the same atom set
C_symbol_ids_are_canonical.name: C_symbol_ids_are_canonical
C_symbol_ids_are_canonical.null_must_contain: a shuffled atom order, which under a first-appearance assignment WOULD produce a different table -- the shuffle is a real perturbation, not a no-op

C_triples_arm_reproduces_S75.can_fail_because: any triple-arm number differs from the value committed in S75/compare.json
C_triples_arm_reproduces_S75.must_fire_because: the second half of the same instrument check, on the key set this spike does not touch at all
C_triples_arm_reproduces_S75.name: C_triples_arm_reproduces_S75
C_triples_arm_reproduces_S75.null_must_contain: S75's committed triple numbers (10.26 pathmap mean depth, 3,160 nodes), independent of anything this spike varies
